lines: Before you ask Allah for more, ask this first.
A king was about to ask for a kingdom like no other. Listen to how he began.
Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, prayed: My Lord, forgive me... and grant me a kingdom.
So before you ask for more today, say it first: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ. Send this to someone who needs it.

beats.text: Before you ask Allah for more, ask this first.
beats.ur: اللہ سے کچھ اور مانگنے سے پہلے… یہ مانگیں

beats.text: A kingdom like no other… listen to how he began.
beats.ur: ایسی بادشاہی جو کسی کو نہ ملی… سنیں انہوں نے دعا کیسے شروع کی

beats.en: My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me

beats.text: Before you ask for more today… say it first: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
beats.ur: آج کچھ اور مانگنے سے پہلے… یہ کہیں: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
